events.title: Lenacapavir will slow HIV infections if there's enough of it and it reaches at-risk groups
events.description: Lenacapavir is one injection, twice a year. It's a big improvement for people in high-risk groups, currently taking a pill a day against HIV infection. But its long-term impact depends on it reaching those very people.

events.title: Flavio Bolsonaro launches Brazil presidential campaign, touts support from Milei

events.title: Women's AFCON 2026: Tournament gets underway after months of delay
events.description: Originally scheduled for last spring, the 2026 Women's Africa Cup of Nations finally kicks off this Sunday in Rabat, Morocco. Algeria take on Senegal in the opening match, while defending champions Nigeria begin their quest to retain the title as the tournament favourites.
